response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT g.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS g ON g.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY g.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - average_share AS difference_from_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
